# appgatesdp_session_info (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `distinguishedname` (String) Distinguished name of the user&devices which will be affected by the operation. Format: 'CN=\<device ID\>,CN=\<username\>,OU=\<provider name\>'

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes Map) The session details per Gateway. The key is the Appliance name and the value contains the Active Client Session details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `device_id` (String) The device ID, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `provider_name` (String) The provider name of the user, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `username` (String) The username, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `device_claims` (String) JSON encoded value; use jsonencode() and jsondecode().
- `discovered_apps` (List of String) The Discovered Apps by this Gateway. Note that this API does not filter out the existing Entitlements like the App Discovery API does. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `entitlement_infos` (Attributes Map) Entitlement information reported by the Gateway. The key is the Entitlement name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--entitlement_infos))
- `site` (String) The Site name for the Gateway.
- `system_claims` (String) JSON encoded value; use jsonencode() and jsondecode().
- `user_claims` (String) JSON encoded value; use jsonencode() and jsondecode().
- `vpn` (String) VPN details of the session JSON encoded value; use jsonencode() and jsondecode().

<a id="nestedatt--data--entitlement_infos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.entitlement_infos`

Read-Only:

- `access` (Boolean) Whether the Entitlement is accessible or not.
- `condition_logic` (String) Whether all the Conditions must succeed to have access to this Entitlement or just one.
- `condition_results` (Map of Boolean) Current results of the Condition evaluations. Entitlement access is decided according to these results. The key is the Condition name.
- `domain_entitlement` (Boolean) Whether the Entitlement has only domain:// type actions. When that is the case, the firewallRules being empty is a normal scenario.
- `firewall_rules` (Attributes List) Current Firewall Rules assigned after evaluating all the Entitlements, Conditions and Name Resolvers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--entitlement_infos--firewall_rules))
- `policy_names` (List of String) Names of the Policies that has granted this Entitlement.
- `primary_site` (String) The name of the primary Site if this entitlements is currently active as part of backup Site feature.

<a id="nestedatt--data--entitlement_infos--firewall_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.entitlement_infos.firewall_rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action for the Firewall Rule.
- `direction` (String) The direction of the Firewall Rrule.
- `hostnames` (List of String) The hostnames the Firewall Rule applies to for name-based Entitlements. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `ports` (List of String) The ports the Firewall Rule applies to.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol for the Firewall Rule.
- `subnets` (List of String) The subnets the Firewall Rule applies to.
- `types` (List of String) The ICMP types the Firewall Rule applies to. Valid for ICMP.
- `urls` (List of String) The URLs the Firewall Rule applies to in case of http_up subtype.
